appDescription: Noraehaja searches and plays Korean karaoke videos while parked, evaluates short recordings, and finds nearby restrooms with parking information and confirmed navigation handoff.

function.name: SEARCH_SONG
function.description: Runs a new video search using the song title or artist in the current request, replaces the displayed song results, and returns numbered matches.

query.description: The song title, artist name, or both supplied in the current search request.

function.name: CONTROL_KARAOKE
function.description: Plays a numbered song from the latest karaoke search results while parked, or opens the Noraehaja app home screen.

operation.description: SELECT plays a numbered song from the current results. OPEN_HOME returns to the Noraehaja app's main screen.

index.description: One-based integer result number required for SELECT. Omit for OPEN_HOME.

function.name: CHECK_SOS_OVERLAY
function.description: Checks the Noraehaja restroom SOS voice connection without opening the app, looking up a location, or changing navigation.
